text: The neighbour's boy went for water and never came back. The watch does not come down here. I have saved a little: find the thing and put an end to it.
Something digs up the fresh graves before I do. The dead do not mind. I do. I will pay from the common jar.

from: A deacon of the Old Grey Chapel
text: The faithful are afraid to come to evening prayer. The Grey Communion asks a hunter to rid the quarter of this plague.

from: The keeper of the Lantern & Hook
text: People stopped staying after dark. Bad for business. Rid us of whatever scares them: a drink and coin are yours.
Something scratches at my shutters every night and people walk round my shop. I am no fighter. You are.
Officially nothing happened. Unofficially, three people vanished this week. The money is from my own pocket, no papers.
We need the creature alive: our patients' wounds match nothing in the books. Bring it breathing and the sisters will pay well.

from: A copyist of the Crypt Scriptorium
text: The Scriptorium needs a living specimen for its register. A dead body lies; a living one does not. We will issue you a net.

from: The Lumen Register, by the Vigil's post
text: The Register will consider raising your rank. Bring down the creature named here, stronger than the rumours say, before the deadline. No excuses are entered in the Register.

from: The keeper of the Lantern & Hook
text: You're the new one with the rifle? Good. Something in the storm drains under Lower Yards has been taking children who go for water. It sings, they say. Kill it, and the first drink of many is on me.

from: Sister Agatha of the Ash Sisters
text: Our sick speak of a tall light that walks the Chapel Close at night and leaves the lamps dead behind it. Do not kill it. Bring it to us alive, in a net, and we will learn what it is. The sisters will remember.

from: Inspector Crane of the Iron Vigil
text: A hound the size of a cart sleeps by the crypt gate of the Old Grey Chapel. It wears what is left of a hunter's coat. The Communion pretends not to see it. The Vigil does see it. Put it down.

from: Mortimer, copyist of the Crypt Scriptorium
text: The crypt floor fell in last night. Something is digging under the chapel, and the ledgers you brought me talk of a 'messenger from below'. If it reaches the street, the Vigil will burn the whole quarter to stop it. Please — before they do.
